ideas.pitch: An offline-first intelligent indoor navigation and resource locator specifically mapped to KSR College of Engineering buildings, utilizing Google Gemini API for real-time natural language query routing.
ideas.title: KSRCE Campus Flow AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since this is hosted by GDG KSRCE, judges will love a localized app that directly solves navigation and event schedule congestion issues on their own campus during the 36-hour offline grind.

ideas.pitch: A regional agricultural support platform tailored for local farmers in Namakkal, offering crop disease detection via image upload and localized yield forecasting using historical regional weather data.
ideas.title: AgriSathi Namakkal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Namakkal is an educational hub surrounded by agricultural communities, making a localized impact project highly appealing to academic and local judges looking for real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: An automated computer lab monitoring system using lightweight computer vision to track equipment usage, safety gear compliance, and student attendance during practical sessions at KSRCE.
ideas.title: SmartLab Attendance & Asset Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets an immediate pain point for college department heads and lab administrators, showcasing practical automation that colleges can deploy the next day.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined certificate verification portal utilizing cryptographic hashing to prevent the forgery of hackathon and workshop certificates issued by student developer clubs in Tamil Nadu.
ideas.title: EduShield Credential Verify
ideas.why_it_could_win: As a project built for and by a developer community club (GDG), an authenticity portal for student achievements directly addresses institutional trust and credential fraud.

ideas.pitch: A real-time food ordering and congestion-prediction app for the KSR College of Engineering canteens, minimizing lunch-break queues through predictive order batching and live kitchen status dashboards.
ideas.title: CampusCanteen Queue Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Every student and faculty member at the offline venue experiences canteen congestion daily, making the demo instantly relatable and engaging for the evaluation panel.
